face.name: 走进失落之城
face.text: 任务：存活10个回合。奖励：拉特维厄斯，城市之眼。
face.flavorText: 第8天。成功了！入夜时分，我们走到一处发光的隧道，入口只有两个瞌睡的托维尔人看守。我们悄悄走过隧道，直接来到了失落之城的核心地带！同胞们一定会用温暖的怀抱迎接我们。

face.name: Enter the Lost City
face.text: Quest: Survive 10 turns. Reward: Latorvius, Gaze of the City.
face.flavorText: Day 8. We’ve done it! As night fell, we came upon a brilliantly glowing tunnel guarded by two slumbering Tol’vir. With silent footsteps, we walked through and emerged into the heart of the Lost City! I’m sure my people will welcome us with open arms.

face.name: 高山之王穆拉丁
face.text: 奇闻 突袭。战吼：为本随从装备高山之王的战锤！亡语：将该战锤置入你的手牌。
face.flavorText: 铁炉堡的史书中最为惨痛的一笔，莫过于穆拉丁国王亲手击毙了堕落的王子阿尔萨斯。巫妖王未能崛起，驭雷者团结如初，可是王子的死还是给联盟留下了一道嫌隙，永远无法弥合。

face.name: Muradin, High King
face.text: Fabled, Rush. Battlecry: Bring the High King's Hammer to ME! Deathrattle: Add it to your hand.
face.flavorText: There is no story more tragic in Ironforge history than that of King Muradin slaying the corrupted Prince Arthas. The Lich King never rose to power, the Stormriders united, but the boy's death created fractures in the Alliance that would never repair.

face.name: 艾雅，玉莲帮主
face.text: 你始终为后手。战吼：在本局对战中，将你的幸运币替换为所选的升级后的伪造幸运币，并获取3张。
face.flavorText: 玉莲帮主在加基森学到了一条真理：不存在什么“盗亦有道”。然而在这里，她又和这群渣滓搅在了一起——他们也没比卡扎库斯强到哪去。

face.name: Aya, Lotus Kingpin
face.text: You always go second. Battlecry: Pick an upgraded counterfeit to replace your Coins this game. Get 3.
face.flavorText: If there's one thing the leader of the Jade Lotus learned back in Gadgetzan, it’s that there is no honor among thieves. And yet here she finds herself again - working with backstabbers no better than Kazakus.

face.name: 灵魂献祭
face.text: 你的英雄技能变为坍缩之星。如果你的技能已经为坍缩之星，其伤害提高1点。
face.flavorText: 这是灵魂残片吗？自从在学园毕业之后就再没见过了！

face.name: Soul Immolation
face.text: Your Hero Power becomes 'Collapsing Star'. If it already is, increase its damage by 1.
face.flavorText: Is that a Soul Fragment? I haven't seen one of those since college!

face.name: 暗中设伏
face.text: 任务：将卡牌洗入你的牌库，总计5次。奖励：暮影 大师。
face.flavorText: 第2天。山里的第一夜有点难受，唉，年纪大了。总觉得有人在监视我们，昨天夜里我绝对看到了什么奇怪的亮光。本打算早餐时问问安布拉，可她一直没露面。

face.name: Lie in Wait
face.text: Quest: Shuffle cards into your deck, 5 times. Reward: Master Dusk.
face.flavorText: Day 2. Our first night in the Crater was a tad rough on this old shell. I can’t shake the feeling that we’re being watched. I swear I saw a glint of shining silver in the dark. I was going to ask Umbra about it at breakfast, but she never turned up.

face.text: Quest: Discard 6 cards. Reward: Nether Portal.

face.text: 任务：对你的随从施放5个法术。 奖励：嘉沃顿。
face.flavorText: “不！这不可能！”白银之手新兵的眼神里充满了恐惧。乌瑟尔摇了摇头，用圣光将水晶点亮：“生命总能自己找到出路。”

face.name: The Last Kaleidosaur
face.text: Quest: Cast 5 spells on your minions. Reward: Galvadon.
face.flavorText: “Impossible!” exclaimed the Silver Hand Recruit, his eyes filled with fear. Uther shook his head, turning the crystal until it caught the light: “Life finds a way.”

policies.scope: Ten complete necessary reachable definitions, zero newly executable Standard collectible roots. Manifest roots are source-evidence candidates only. All five parents and Latorvius remain unsupported; no Quest, Fabled, hero or counterfeit-Coin producer is registered. Wild-only work is deferred; seven cross-series noncollectibles are actual Standard dependencies.
policies.portal: Native permanent_dormancy with explicit None countdown and dormant owner-end triggers. The actual reward spell uses one attributed ordinary summon; each real permanent carrier uses two attributed Imp requests at owner end. Native capacity, quantity, dormant restrictions and nondeath removal remain; exact open-vs-summon and CN windows are M6.
policies.adapt: Five independent native Adapt three-of-ten samples, same original surviving minion reference throughout. Existing ten choices and Plant definitions are pinned unchanged. Each native option recipe is delegated through original-recipient guards; Living Spores uses an attributed two-Plant Deathrattle rather than a legacy source-free Summon. Complete options, stacking and next-owner-start Stealth remain native policies pending M6.
policies.jade: Four exact classic source templates and native JadeGolemFamily. Innate sizes, thresholds1/4/7/20, shared growth,30 cap,10 Cost cap, copies and retirement reuse existing Jade rules. No inferred new artwork family and no Jade Coin adapter; the actual Coin source explicitly references classic first template42098. Correct art identity and full source interaction remain M6.
policies.avatar: Temporary native trigger and +2 Attack grant on one original friendly character until the accepted global turn ends. After that physical character completes an attack, native character-attack fact gates one2-damage enemy batch. Minion abilities retain carrier provenance, hero grants use ordinary EFFECT provenance; no Spell Damage reinterpretation. Sequential grants and hero inheritance remain M6.
policies.star: Printed initial script value2, native random enemy HERO_POWER damage and original installed-power RefreshHeroPower after own Demon/ALL summon. No Soul Immolation root or mutable damage-upgrade workaround; initial printed power face only. Summon/refresh acceptance and exact CN upgrades remain M6.
policies.shell: Native starting_deck_identity supplies original physical entity membership; no card-name substitute. Each of two actual physical random deck draws independently requeries nonstarting entities, then native MoveCard(draw=True) handles draw replacement and overflow. Unknown Scenario origin explicitly errors and rolls back; original-power and starting-identity policies remain M6.
